links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of AI-generated type 2 diabetes patient leaflets
links.effect: Mean Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level was 8.30 (SD 1.92) for AI-generated leaflets and 8.67 (SD 2.23) for websites, an eighth- to ninth-grade level, above the UK average reading age of 9 years.
links.quote: Mean Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level scores for websites were 8.67 (SD 2.23) and 8.30 (SD 1.92) for AIGLs, corresponding to an eighth- to ninth-grade comprehension level.

screen.reason: Evaluates quality, readability, and transparency of diabetes information generated by LLMs compared to existing websites without testing a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
